newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Eurobank leads $50mln FRN backed by Russia MinFins.
newsitem.headline: Eurobank leads $50mln FRN backed by Russia MinFins.

text.p: Banque Commerciale pour l'Europe du Nord-Eurobank (BCEN-Eurobank) said on Thursday it had lead-managed a private placement of $50 million floating rate notes, secured by third tranche Russian MinFin bonds.
The repackaged notes were issued by Cayman Islands financing vehicle High Income World Ltd (HI-WORLD), and the issue was arranged by Societe Generale.
BCEN-Eurobank and arranger Societe Generale declined to say who had set up Hi-World.
